more.headline: Rabid otter pounces on a Florida Man biting his legs, hands and arms 41 times as he fed the ducks - before it turned on a couple's pet dog
more.summary: Joseph Scaglione, 73, was feeding ducks in the backyard of his Jupiter, Florida home when he was jumped by the otter - who later tested positive for rabies.

more.headline: Florida Man arrested after allegedly stealing from car at south Forsyth daycare
more.summary: A Florida Man is in the Forsyth County Jail in connection with a theft from a vehicle outside a south Forsyth County daycare.

more.headline: Elderly Florida Man savagely attacked, bitten by rabid otter 41 times while feeding ducks
more.summary: The crazed critter was later captured and euthanized.

more.headline: Florida Man, 74, attacked by rabid otter while feeding ducks
more.summary: A Florida Man was bitten by a rabid otter.

more.headline: Florida Man busted for keeping threatened tortoise species in household bucket, FWC says
more.summary: A Florida Man was arrested after he was caught illegally keeping a threatened tortoise species in a 5-gallon bucket in his home, according to the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission.

more.headline: Rabid otter attacks Florida Man, bites him 41 times
more.summary: He said he tried to back away, but the otter pounced and he tripped.

more.headline: Florida Man bit 41 times by rabid otter, report says
more.summary: WFLA reported this one on September 26, 2023. Full story at the source.

more.headline: Florida Man accused of beating ex-girlfriend, good Samaritan arrested in Lake County
more.summary: A man accused of beating his former girlfriend and then severely beating another man who tried to intervene was arrested in Lake County, according to the Polk County Sheriff’s Office.

more.headline: Florida Man shoots bear after it breaks into his family home
more.summary: A Florida Man shot a bear in his bathroom after it broke into his family home in DeLand, and scared his mother-in-law, who was in the living room of the house.

story.headline: Florida Man faces 13 counts for illegal alligator hunting, allegedly posing with carcasses
story.summary: A Florida Man is facing 13 felony charges after investigators say he turned his airboat into a poaching platform, capturing and killing alligators.
